Treatment summary
Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of neck and low back pain. The reported
mechanism is consistent with the injuries described, and the presenting symptoms align well with the force involved. Initial
examination revealed paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced cervical range of motion, while straight-leg raise and reflex
testing were within normal limits. Past history is notable for a minor strain to the same region years ago, which resolved
completely without residual limitation. Conservative care was provided over 24 visits, including manual therapy, stretching, and
home exercise instruction. The course of treatment ran somewhat longer than typical for this type of strain, though progress was
steady. Billing records reflect individual visits with no duplicate or repeated charges. Patient continues to improve and is
expected to return to full activities with ongoing home exercise.
</page>

it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
